muhurlu-bogaz-kelepcesi.Blocked: {actor} cannot cast spells or use magic-required activities while wearing {collar}.
muhurlu-bogaz-kelepcesi.NoAttune: {actor} cannot attune to an item while wearing {collar}.
muhurlu-bogaz-kelepcesi.LockedModify: {collar} is locked; only the Game Master can remove or modify it.
muhurlu-bogaz-kelepcesi.LockedDelete: {collar} is locked; only the Game Master can delete it.

Sheet.Label: Suppresses magic
Sheet.Hint: While equipped, the wearer can't cast spells or attune, and ongoing concentration ends. Players can't remove it.

BlockMagicItems.Name: Also block magic items
BlockMagicItems.Hint: When enabled, every activity of items with the Magical property is also blocked while the collar is worn. When disabled, only spells and magic-required activities are blocked.
